animals-01.zh: 狮子。狮子有一圈蓬松的鬃毛，像戴着小围巾。
animals-01.en: Lion. The lion has a fluffy mane around his neck, like a little scarf.

animals-02.zh: 熊猫。熊猫穿着黑白衣服，最爱吃竹子。
animals-02.en: Panda. The panda has a black and white coat and loves to eat bamboo.

animals-03.zh: 兔子。兔子的耳朵长长的，蹦蹦跳跳真可爱。
animals-03.en: Rabbit. The rabbit has long ears and hops along so sweetly.

animals-04.zh: 大象。大象的鼻子长长的，可以卷起食物。
animals-04.en: Elephant. The elephant has a long trunk that can pick up food.

animals-05.zh: 长颈鹿。长颈鹿的脖子长长的，能吃到高处的树叶。
animals-05.en: Giraffe. The giraffe has a long neck that helps it reach leaves high in the trees.

animals-06.zh: 小猫。小猫喵喵叫，嘴边长着细细的胡须。
animals-06.en: Cat. The cat says meow and has fine whiskers beside its mouth.

animals-07.zh: 小狗。小狗汪汪叫，摇摇尾巴来问好。
animals-07.en: Dog. The dog says woof and wags its tail to say hello.

animals-08.zh: 老虎。老虎的身上有一道道黑色的条纹。
animals-08.en: Tiger. The tiger has black stripes on its body.

animals-09.zh: 猴子。猴子会爬树，用小手抓住树枝。
animals-09.en: Monkey. The monkey climbs trees and holds the branches with its little hands.

animals-10.zh: 斑马。斑马穿着黑白条纹的衣服。
animals-10.en: Zebra. The zebra has a coat with black and white stripes.

animals-11.zh: 小熊。小熊的身体胖胖的，耳朵圆圆的。
animals-11.en: Bear. The little bear has a plump body and round ears.

animals-12.zh: 狐狸。狐狸的尾巴蓬蓬的，耳朵尖尖的。
animals-12.en: Fox. The fox has a fluffy tail and pointy ears.

animals-13.zh: 松鼠。松鼠有一条大尾巴，喜欢在树上活动。
animals-13.en: Squirrel. The squirrel has a big tail and likes to move around in the trees.

animals-14.zh: 考拉。考拉抱着树枝，吃桉树的叶子。
animals-14.en: Koala. The koala holds on to a branch and eats eucalyptus leaves.

animals-15.zh: 河马。河马的嘴巴大大的，喜欢待在水里。
animals-15.en: Hippopotamus. The hippopotamus has a big mouth and likes to stay in the water.

animals-16.zh: 企鹅。企鹅摇摇摆摆走路，在水里游得很快。
animals-16.en: Penguin. The penguin waddles when it walks and swims fast in the water.

animals-17.zh: 鸭子。鸭子嘎嘎叫，小脚像一把把小扇子。
animals-17.en: Duck. The duck says quack, and its little feet look like little fans.

animals-18.zh: 猫头鹰。猫头鹰的眼睛大大的，很多猫头鹰夜里活动。
animals-18.en: Owl. Owls have big eyes, and many owls are active at night.

animals-19.zh: 海豚。海豚在海里游泳，会到水面上呼吸。
animals-19.en: Dolphin. The dolphin swims in the sea and comes up to the surface to breathe.

animals-20.zh: 乌龟。乌龟背着硬硬的壳，慢慢地向前爬。
animals-20.en: Turtle. The turtle has a hard shell on its back and crawls along slowly.

fruits-01.zh: 苹果。苹果圆圆的，咬一口脆脆的。
fruits-01.en: Apple. An apple is round and crunchy to eat.

fruits-02.zh: 香蕉。香蕉弯弯的，像一轮小月亮。
fruits-02.en: Banana. A banana is curved like a little moon.

fruits-03.zh: 橙子。橙子穿着橙色的外衣，果汁甜甜酸酸。
fruits-03.en: Orange. An orange has orange skin and sweet, tangy juice.

fruits-04.zh: 葡萄。一颗颗葡萄聚在一起，变成一串。
fruits-04.en: Grapes. Grapes grow together in a bunch.

fruits-05.zh: 草莓。草莓红红的，身上有好多小点点。
fruits-05.en: Strawberry. A strawberry is red with lots of tiny dots.

fruits-06.zh: 西瓜。西瓜外面绿绿的，里面的果肉水分多。
fruits-06.en: Watermelon. A watermelon is green on the outside and juicy on the inside.

fruits-07.zh: 梨。梨的肚子圆圆的，吃起来脆脆甜甜。
fruits-07.en: Pear. A pear has a round belly and tastes sweet and crunchy.

fruits-08.zh: 桃子。桃子粉粉的，有的外皮有细细的绒毛。
fruits-08.en: Peach. Peaches are pink, and some have soft fuzz on their skin.

fruits-09.zh: 菠萝。菠萝头上长着一簇尖尖的绿叶。
fruits-09.en: Pineapple. A pineapple has a bunch of pointy green leaves on top.

fruits-10.zh: 芒果。芒果的果肉金黄，闻起来香香的。
fruits-10.en: Mango. A mango is golden inside and smells sweet.

fruits-11.zh: 猕猴桃。猕猴桃切开后，能看见一圈小种子。
fruits-11.en: Kiwi. Inside a cut kiwi, you can see a ring of tiny seeds.

fruits-12.zh: 樱桃。樱桃小小圆圆的，连着细细的果柄。
fruits-12.en: Cherries. Cherries are small and round, with thin stems.

fruits-13.zh: 蓝莓。蓝莓是一颗颗蓝紫色的小果子。
fruits-13.en: Blueberries. Blueberries are little blue-purple fruits.

fruits-14.zh: 柠檬。柠檬黄黄的，尝起来酸酸的。
fruits-14.en: Lemon. A lemon is yellow and tastes sour.

fruits-15.zh: 火龙果。火龙果的果肉里，藏着好多黑色小种子。
fruits-15.en: Dragon fruit. A dragon fruit has lots of tiny black seeds inside.

fruits-16.zh: 椰子。椰子的外壳硬硬的，里面有椰子水。
fruits-16.en: Coconut. A coconut has a hard shell with coconut water inside.

fruits-17.zh: 柿子。成熟的柿子橙红橙红，像一盏小灯笼。
fruits-17.en: Persimmon. A ripe persimmon is orange-red, like a little lantern.

fruits-18.zh: 石榴。石榴里面藏着一颗颗亮亮的小果粒。
fruits-18.en: Pomegranate. A pomegranate has lots of shiny little seeds inside.

fruits-19.zh: 荔枝。荔枝剥开外皮，果肉白白的。
fruits-19.en: Lychee. Under its skin, a lychee is white inside.

fruits-20.zh: 哈密瓜。哈密瓜的果肉甜甜的，外皮常有网纹。
fruits-20.en: Cantaloupe. A cantaloupe is sweet inside, and its skin often has a net-like pattern.

weather-01.zh: 晴天。太阳出来啦，暖暖的阳光洒下来。
weather-01.en: Sunny. The sun is out, and its light feels warm.

weather-02.zh: 白云。白云飘在天空，像软软的棉花。
weather-02.en: Cloud. White clouds float in the sky like soft cotton.

weather-03.zh: 下雨。滴答滴答，小雨点从天空落下来。
weather-03.en: Rain. Pitter-patter! Little raindrops fall from the sky.

weather-04.zh: 下雪。小雪花飘下来，给大地盖上白被子。
weather-04.en: Snow. Snowflakes float down and cover the ground like a white blanket.

weather-05.zh: 彩虹。雨后有时能看见彩虹，弯弯的，颜色真多。
weather-05.en: Rainbow. Sometimes a colorful, curved rainbow appears after the rain.

weather-06.zh: 刮风。风吹过来，树叶轻轻摇。
weather-06.en: Wind. The wind blows, and the leaves sway gently.

weather-07.zh: 闪电。天空闪了一下！雷雨时和大人待在安全的室内。
weather-07.en: Lightning. A bright flash lights up the sky! Stay safely indoors with a grown-up during a thunderstorm.

weather-08.zh: 雾。雾像薄薄的白纱，远处的东西看不清。
weather-08.en: Fog. Fog is like a thin white curtain that makes faraway things hard to see.

weather-09.zh: 阴天。云把太阳遮住了，天空灰灰的。
weather-09.en: Cloudy. Clouds cover the sun, and the sky looks gray.

weather-10.zh: 星星。夜晚的天空，有好多亮亮的星星。
weather-10.en: Stars. Lots of bright stars shine in the night sky.

weather-11.zh: 月亮。月亮有时圆圆的，有时弯弯的。
weather-11.en: Moon. Sometimes the moon looks round, and sometimes it looks like a curve.

weather-12.zh: 日出。早晨，太阳慢慢从天边升起来。
weather-12.en: Sunrise. In the morning, the sun slowly rises at the edge of the sky.

weather-13.zh: 晚霞。傍晚的云，有时会变成粉红色和橙色。
weather-13.en: Sunset glow. In the evening, clouds sometimes turn pink and orange.

weather-14.zh: 露珠。早晨的叶子上，挂着小小的露珠。
weather-14.en: Dew. In the morning, tiny drops of dew sit on the leaves.

weather-15.zh: 霜。很冷的早晨，草叶上可能有白白的霜。
weather-15.en: Frost. On a very cold morning, white frost may cover the grass.

weather-16.zh: 冰。水遇到足够冷的天气，就会结成冰。
weather-16.en: Ice. When it gets cold enough, water freezes into ice.

weather-17.zh: 雨伞。下雨时撑起小伞，挡住落下的雨点。
weather-17.en: Umbrella. Open an umbrella when it rains to keep the raindrops off.

weather-18.zh: 雨靴。下雨天穿雨靴，让小脚保持干爽。
weather-18.en: Rain boots. Wear rain boots on rainy days to keep your feet dry.

weather-19.zh: 遮阳帽。阳光强的时候，出门记得戴上遮阳帽。
weather-19.en: Sun hat. Remember to wear a sun hat outside when the sun is bright.

weather-20.zh: 雪人。和大人一起，把白白的雪堆成雪人。
weather-20.en: Snowman. Build a snowman out of white snow with a grown-up.

objects-01.zh: 杯子。小杯子，装好水，口渴了喝一口。
objects-01.en: Cup. Fill your little cup with water and take a sip when you feel thirsty.

objects-02.zh: 勺子。小勺子，可以舀起饭菜。
objects-02.en: Spoon. A little spoon helps you scoop up food.

objects-03.zh: 碗。小碗里装着香香的饭。
objects-03.en: Bowl. The little bowl holds yummy rice.

objects-04.zh: 盘子。盘子平平的，可以放好吃的食物。
objects-04.en: Plate. A plate is flat and holds yummy food.

objects-05.zh: 牙刷。小牙刷，每天帮我们清洁牙齿。
objects-05.en: Toothbrush. A little toothbrush helps us clean our teeth every day.

objects-06.zh: 毛巾。软软的毛巾，擦擦小手和小脸。
objects-06.en: Towel. A soft towel wipes your little hands and face.

objects-07.zh: 鞋子。穿上合脚的鞋子，保护我们的小脚。
objects-07.en: Shoes. Shoes that fit well help protect your little feet.

objects-08.zh: 袜子。小袜子，套在脚上暖暖的。
objects-08.en: Socks. Put socks on your feet to keep them warm.

objects-09.zh: 帽子。小帽子，戴在头顶上。
objects-09.en: Hat. A little hat goes on your head.

objects-10.zh: 上衣。伸伸手，穿上干净的小上衣。
objects-10.en: Shirt. Stretch out your arms and put on a clean shirt.

objects-11.zh: 裤子。小裤子，有两个裤腿。
objects-11.en: Pants. A pair of pants has two legs.

objects-12.zh: 书包。小书包，可以装下书和小物品。
objects-12.en: Schoolbag. A little schoolbag holds books and small things.

objects-13.zh: 皮球。圆圆的皮球，拍一拍，跳起来。
objects-13.en: Ball. Pat the round ball and watch it bounce.

objects-14.zh: 玩具车。小小玩具车，推一推，向前走。
objects-14.en: Toy car. Give the little toy car a push, and it rolls forward.

objects-15.zh: 积木。把大块积木叠起来，搭一座小房子。
objects-15.en: Building blocks. Stack big building blocks to make a little house.

objects-16.zh: 图画书。翻开图画书，一起看看里面的故事。
objects-16.en: Picture book. Open a picture book and explore the story together.

objects-17.zh: 椅子。小椅子，坐下来休息一下。
objects-17.en: Chair. Sit on the little chair and take a rest.

objects-18.zh: 桌子。桌子上，可以放书和画纸。
objects-18.en: Table. A table can hold books and drawing paper.

objects-19.zh: 小床。躺在小床上，安安静静睡个好觉。
objects-19.en: Bed. Lie down in your little bed and have a peaceful sleep.

objects-20.zh: 时钟。时钟告诉我们，现在是什么时间。
objects-20.en: Clock. A clock tells us what time it is.

hanzi-01.zh: 日。日，就是太阳。太阳出来了！

hanzi-02.zh: 月。月，就是月亮。月亮挂在天上。
hanzi-02.en: Moon. The moon is up in the sky.

hanzi-03.en: Mountain. A mountain has tall peaks.

hanzi-04.en: Water. Water can flow into a river.

hanzi-05.zh: 木。木，让我们想到一棵树。
hanzi-05.en: Tree. This character makes us think of a tree.

hanzi-06.en: Person. You and I are both people.

hanzi-07.en: Mouth. Open your mouth and say hello.

hanzi-08.en: Hand. Hold up your little hand and wave.

hanzi-09.zh: 足。足，就是脚。小脚慢慢走。
hanzi-09.en: Foot. Take slow steps with your little feet.

hanzi-10.zh: 目。目，就是眼睛。用眼睛看世界。
hanzi-10.en: Eye. We use our eyes to see the world.

hanzi-11.zh: 耳。耳朵听一听，小鸟在唱歌。
hanzi-11.en: Ear. Listen with your ears. A little bird is singing.

hanzi-12.en: Field. We can grow crops in a field.

hanzi-13.zh: 火。火很烫，只能远远地看，不可以碰。
hanzi-13.en: Fire. Fire is very hot. Stay far away and never touch it.

hanzi-14.zh: 石。石头硬硬的，有大也有小。
hanzi-14.en: Stone. Stones are hard. Some are big, and some are small.

hanzi-15.zh: 花。花儿开了，颜色真漂亮。
hanzi-15.en: Flower. The flowers are blooming in beautiful colors.

hanzi-16.zh: 鸟。小鸟长着羽毛和翅膀。
hanzi-16.en: Bird. A little bird has feathers and wings.

hanzi-17.zh: 鱼。小鱼摆摆尾巴，在水里游。
hanzi-17.en: Fish. The little fish wiggles its tail and swims in the water.

hanzi-18.zh: 马。小马有四条腿，跑得快。
hanzi-18.en: Horse. A horse has four legs and can run fast.

hanzi-19.zh: 牛。小牛哞哞叫，低头吃青草。
hanzi-19.en: Cow. The cow says moo and lowers its head to eat green grass.

hanzi-20.zh: 羊。小羊咩咩叫，身上长着毛。
hanzi-20.en: Sheep. The sheep says baa and has a woolly coat.

phrases-01.en: Drink water. I would like some water.

phrases-02.en: Eat a meal. I am ready to eat!

phrases-03.en: Wash your hands. Let's wash our hands before we eat.

phrases-04.en: Brush your teeth. Let's brush our teeth together.

phrases-05.en: Wash your face. Wash your little face. Now it is nice and clean!

phrases-06.en: Put on your shoes. I want to put on my shoes.

phrases-07.zh: 戴帽子。出门啦，戴好帽子。
phrases-07.en: Put on your hat. We are going outside. Let's put on a hat.

phrases-08.en: Go to sleep. Good night. I am going to sleep.

phrases-09.en: Wake up. Good morning. I am up!

phrases-10.en: Read a book. Let's read a book together.

phrases-11.en: Bounce a ball. Let's bounce the little ball.

phrases-12.zh: 抱一抱。妈妈，我想抱一抱。
phrases-12.en: Give me a hug. Mommy, I would like a hug.

phrases-13.zh: 你好。你好，很高兴见到你。
phrases-13.en: Hello. Hello, it is nice to see you.

phrases-14.zh: 再见。挥挥手，我们下次见。
phrases-14.en: Goodbye. Wave goodbye. See you next time!

phrases-15.en: Thank you. Thank you for helping me.

phrases-16.zh: 对不起。对不起，我不是故意的。
phrases-16.en: Sorry. I am sorry. I did not mean to do that.

phrases-17.zh: 慢慢走。小脚慢慢走，不着急。
phrases-17.en: Walk slowly. Take slow little steps. There is no hurry.

phrases-18.zh: 收玩具。玩好啦，把玩具送回家。
phrases-18.en: Put away your toys. We are done playing. Let's put the toys back where they belong.

phrases-19.en: Look at the flowers. Look at the beautiful flowers!

phrases-20.zh: 听音乐。听一听，音乐真好听。
phrases-20.en: Listen to music. Listen to the music. It sounds lovely.

transport-01.zh: 小汽车。小汽车有四个轮子，载着我们出门。
transport-01.en: Car. A car has four wheels and can take us out.

transport-02.zh: 公交车。公交车长长的，停下来让大家上车。
transport-02.en: Bus. A bus is long and stops so people can get on.

transport-03.zh: 自行车。自行车有两个轮子，脚踩踏板就会走。
transport-03.en: Bicycle. A bicycle has two wheels and moves when we pedal.

transport-04.zh: 火车。火车一节连着一节，沿着铁轨往前开。
transport-04.en: Train. A train is cars linked together, rolling along the tracks.

transport-05.zh: 地铁。地铁在地下跑，到站就会打开车门。
transport-05.en: Subway. A subway train runs underground and opens its doors at the station.

transport-06.zh: 飞机。飞机有大大的翅膀，能飞上高高的天空。
transport-06.en: Airplane. An airplane has big wings and flies high in the sky.

transport-07.zh: 轮船。轮船大大的，在水面上慢慢往前走。
transport-07.en: Ship. A ship is big and moves slowly on the water.

transport-08.zh: 消防车。消防车红红的，带着长长的水管。
transport-08.en: Fire truck. A fire truck is red and carries long hoses.

transport-09.zh: 救护车。救护车白白的，把需要帮助的人送到医院。
transport-09.en: Ambulance. An ambulance is white and takes people who need help to the hospital.

transport-10.zh: 挖掘机。挖掘机有长长的铁手臂，可以挖土。
transport-10.en: Excavator. An excavator has a long metal arm that can dig dirt.

vegetables-01.zh: 胡萝卜。胡萝卜橙橙的，长得像一根小棍子。
vegetables-01.en: Carrot. A carrot is orange and shaped like a little stick.

vegetables-02.zh: 黄瓜。黄瓜绿绿长长的，咬一口清清脆脆。
vegetables-02.en: Cucumber. A cucumber is green and long, and it tastes cool and crunchy.

vegetables-03.zh: 西红柿。西红柿圆圆红红的，里面有小小的籽。
vegetables-03.en: Tomato. A tomato is round and red, with tiny seeds inside.

vegetables-04.zh: 土豆。土豆圆圆的，外皮浅棕色，做熟了软软的。
vegetables-04.en: Potato. A potato has light brown skin and turns soft when it is cooked.

vegetables-05.zh: 南瓜。南瓜圆圆的，穿着橙橙的厚外衣。
vegetables-05.en: Pumpkin. A pumpkin is round with thick orange skin.

vegetables-06.zh: 白菜。白菜叶子一层一层，白白的帮，绿绿的叶。
vegetables-06.en: Chinese cabbage. Chinese cabbage has layered leaves with white stems and green tops.

vegetables-07.zh: 西兰花。西兰花绿绿的，头顶像一棵小小树。
vegetables-07.en: Broccoli. Broccoli is green, and the top looks like a tiny tree.

vegetables-08.zh: 茄子。茄子紫亮紫亮，身子长长的。
vegetables-08.en: Eggplant. An eggplant is shiny purple and has a long body.

vegetables-09.zh: 玉米。玉米金黄金黄，一颗颗玉米粒排得齐齐的。
vegetables-09.en: Corn. Corn is golden, with kernels lined up in neat rows.

food-01.zh: 米饭。米饭白白的，一粒一粒盛在小碗里。
food-01.en: Rice. Rice is white, with little grains served in a bowl.

food-02.zh: 面条。面条长长细细的，盛在碗里热热的。
food-02.en: Noodles. Noodles are long and thin, served warm in a bowl.

food-03.zh: 馒头。馒头白白软软，圆圆的，里面没有馅。
food-03.en: Steamed bun. A steamed bun is white and soft, with no filling inside.

food-04.zh: 包子。包子圆圆鼓鼓的，里面藏着香香的馅。
food-04.en: Bao. A bao is round and puffy, with a tasty filling inside.

food-05.zh: 饺子。饺子像小口袋，薄皮包着馅。
food-05.en: Dumpling. A dumpling is a little pocket with filling inside a thin skin.

food-06.zh: 面包。面包松松软软，可以撕成小块。
food-06.en: Bread. Bread is soft and fluffy, and we can tear off a little piece.

food-07.zh: 鸡蛋。鸡蛋椭圆椭圆的，煮熟剥开有蛋白和蛋黄。
food-07.en: Egg. A cooked egg is oval; peel it to find the white and the yellow yolk.

food-08.zh: 豆腐。豆腐白白嫩嫩，一晃一晃软软的。
food-08.en: Tofu. Tofu is white and tender, and it feels soft on the spoon.

food-09.zh: 粥。米加水慢慢煮，就变成了软软稠稠的粥。
food-09.en: Rice porridge. Rice porridge is rice cooked until it is very soft.

food-10.zh: 牛奶。牛奶白白的，倒进杯子里小口喝。
food-10.en: Milk. Milk is white. Pour it into a cup and take little sips.

places-01.zh: 公园。公园里有树和小路，还有可以玩的空地。
places-01.en: Park. A park has trees, paths, and open space to play.

places-02.zh: 超市。超市里一排排货架，装着吃的和用的。
places-02.en: Supermarket. A supermarket has long shelves of food and things we use at home.

places-03.zh: 菜市场。菜市场很热闹，摊上摆着新鲜的菜。
places-03.en: Food market. A food market is busy, with stalls of fresh vegetables.

places-04.zh: 医院。医院是医生工作的地方，楼里有安静的走廊。
places-04.en: Hospital. A hospital is where doctors work, with quiet hallways inside.

places-05.zh: 车站。车站是等车的地方，车来了再和大人上车。
places-05.en: Station. A station is where we wait, then get on with a grown-up.

places-06.zh: 图书馆。图书馆里有好多书，我们可以轻轻地看。
places-06.en: Library. A library has lots of books, and we can look at them quietly.

places-07.zh: 幼儿园。幼儿园里有小朋友，大家一起玩、听故事。
places-07.en: Kindergarten. Kindergarten has little friends who play and listen to stories together.

places-08.zh: 游乐场。游乐场里有旋转的小设施，灯亮亮的很好看。
places-08.en: Amusement park. An amusement park has little rides and bright lights to look at with a grown-up.

objects-21.zh: 电脑。电脑有亮亮的屏幕，上面会显示图画。
objects-21.en: Computer. A computer has a bright screen that can show pictures.

objects-22.zh: 电话。电话可以传来声音，让我们和远处的人说话。
objects-22.en: Phone. A phone carries voices so we can talk with someone far away.

objects-23.zh: 冰箱。冰箱里面凉凉的，可以把食物放进去保鲜。
objects-23.en: Refrigerator. A refrigerator is cool inside and keeps food fresh.

objects-24.zh: 洗衣机。洗衣机转动起来，衣服在水里转圈圈。
objects-24.en: Washing machine. A washing machine turns, and the clothes spin around in the water.

objects-25.zh: 电风扇。电风扇的叶子转起来，送来一阵凉风。
objects-25.en: Fan. A fan's blades spin and send a cool breeze.

objects-26.zh: 吸尘器。吸尘器嗡嗡响，把地上的灰尘吸进去。
objects-26.en: Vacuum cleaner. A vacuum cleaner hums and sucks up dust from the floor.

objects-27.zh: 台灯。台灯站在桌子上，亮起来光是柔柔的。
objects-27.en: Lamp. A lamp stands on the table and gives a soft light.

objects-28.zh: 沙发。沙发软软的，坐上去可以靠一靠。
objects-28.en: Sofa. A sofa is soft, and we can sit down and lean back.

objects-29.zh: 镜子。镜子亮亮平平的，可以看见自己的小脸。
objects-29.en: Mirror. A mirror is shiny and flat, and we can see our little face in it.

objects-30.zh: 梳子。梳子有一排细齿，可以轻轻梳头发。
objects-30.en: Comb. A comb has a row of thin teeth and can gently smooth hair.

objects-31.zh: 被子。被子软软厚厚的，盖在身上暖暖的。
objects-31.en: Blanket. A blanket is soft and thick, and it keeps us warm.

animals-21.zh: 小猪。小猪的鼻子圆圆的，身上粉粉的，会哼哼叫。
animals-21.en: Pig. A pig has a round nose and a pink body, and it says oink.

animals-22.zh: 小鸡。小鸡圆滚滚的，身上是软软的黄羽毛，会唧唧叫。
animals-22.en: Chick. A chick is round and fluffy, with soft yellow down, and it says peep.

animals-23.zh: 鹅。鹅的脖子长长的，走路一摇一摆。
animals-23.en: Goose. A goose has a long neck and waddles as it walks.

animals-24.zh: 蝴蝶。蝴蝶有两对翅膀，会在花旁边轻轻飞。
animals-24.en: Butterfly. A butterfly has two pairs of wings and flutters beside the flowers.

animals-25.zh: 蜗牛。蜗牛背上顶着小壳，走起路来慢慢的。
animals-25.en: Snail. A snail carries a little shell on its back and moves very slowly.

animals-26.zh: 蚂蚁。蚂蚁小小的，常常排着队往前走。
animals-26.en: Ant. Ants are tiny and often walk forward in a line.

animals-27.zh: 蜜蜂。蜜蜂嗡嗡飞，停在花上采花蜜。
animals-27.en: Bee. A bee buzzes and stops on flowers to gather nectar.

animals-28.zh: 瓢虫。瓢虫圆圆的，背上常有黑色小点点。
animals-28.en: Ladybug. A ladybug is round, and its back often has little black spots.

animals-29.zh: 毛毛虫。毛毛虫圆滚滚的，一拱一拱地往前走。
animals-29.en: Caterpillar. A caterpillar is plump and scooches forward in little arches.

phrases-21.zh: 跳一跳。我们一起跳一跳。
phrases-21.en: Jump. Let's take a little jump together.

phrases-22.en: Clap your hands. Let's clap our hands.

phrases-23.zh: 蹲下来。我们慢慢蹲下来。
phrases-23.en: Squat down. Let's squat down slowly.

phrases-24.en: Let me try. Let me try.

phrases-26.en: I don't want this. I don't want this.

phrases-27.en: I am happy. I am so happy.

phrases-28.zh: 我有点害怕。我有点害怕。
phrases-28.en: I am a little scared. I feel a little scared.

phrases-29.zh: 我想休息。我想休息一下。
phrases-29.en: I want to rest. I would like to rest.

weather-21.zh: 大海。大海蓝蓝的，浪花一层层拍在岸边。
weather-21.en: Ocean. The ocean is blue, and little waves tap the shore.

weather-22.zh: 小溪。小溪的水绕过石头，轻轻地往前流。
weather-22.en: Stream. A stream flows gently around the stones.

weather-23.zh: 瀑布。瀑布从高处落下来，溅起白白的水花。
weather-23.en: Waterfall. A waterfall pours down from high up and makes white splashes.

weather-24.zh: 沙滩。沙滩软软的，细沙子可以漏过手指缝。
weather-24.en: Beach. A beach has soft sand that can slip through your fingers.

weather-25.zh: 草地。草地绿绿软软的，小草一棵挨着一棵。
weather-25.en: Grass. The grass is green and soft, with little blades standing side by side.

fruits-21.zh: 橘子。橘子小小的，皮下面是一瓣一瓣的果肉。
fruits-21.en: Mandarin orange. A mandarin orange is small, with juicy segments under its peel.

fruits-22.zh: 柚子。柚子圆圆大大的，皮厚厚的，果肉一瓣一瓣。
fruits-22.en: Pomelo. A pomelo is big and round, with a thick peel and juicy segments.

fruits-23.zh: 杏。杏圆圆的，熟了黄黄的，中间有一颗硬核。
fruits-23.en: Apricot. An apricot is round and turns yellow when ripe, with a hard pit in the middle.

fruits-24.zh: 李子。李子圆圆的，皮光滑，咬一口汁水很多。
fruits-24.en: Plum. A plum is round and smooth, and it is very juicy inside.

fruits-25.zh: 山竹。山竹紫紫的，剥开厚皮是白白的果肉。
fruits-25.en: Mangosteen. A mangosteen is purple; under the thick peel, the fruit is white.

fruits-26.zh: 杨梅。杨梅红红的，表面一颗颗小凸起，酸酸甜甜。
fruits-26.en: Bayberry. A bayberry is red with a bumpy surface, and it tastes sweet and tart.

animals-30.zh: 小鱼。小鱼在水里游，尾巴一摆一摆。
animals-30.en: Fish. A little fish swims in the water and wags its tail.

animals-31.zh: 青蛙。青蛙蹲在荷叶上，跳起来又远又稳。
animals-31.en: Frog. The frog sits on a lily pad and jumps far and steady.

animals-32.zh: 螃蟹。螃蟹横着走路，举着两只大钳子。
animals-32.en: Crab. The crab walks sideways and holds up two big claws.

animals-33.zh: 绵羊。绵羊的毛卷卷的，像一朵白云。
animals-33.en: Sheep. The sheep has curly wool like a little cloud.

animals-34.zh: 小鹿。小鹿头上长着小角，跑起来很轻快。
animals-34.en: Deer. The little deer has small antlers and runs lightly.

animals-35.zh: 刺猬。刺猬背上长满小刺，遇到危险就缩成一团。
animals-35.en: Hedgehog. A hedgehog has little spines on its back and rolls up when it feels unsafe.

vegetables-10.zh: 蘑菇。蘑菇像一把小伞，有圆圆的伞盖。
vegetables-10.en: Mushroom. A mushroom looks like a little umbrella with a round cap.

vegetables-11.zh: 豆角。豆角长长的，里面有小小的豆子。
vegetables-11.en: Green beans. Green beans are long and have small beans inside.

vegetables-12.zh: 菠菜。菠菜的叶子绿绿的，煮熟以后软软的。
vegetables-12.en: Spinach. Spinach has green leaves and turns soft when cooked.

vegetables-13.zh: 洋葱。洋葱一层一层包着，切开时有点辣眼睛。
vegetables-13.en: Onion. An onion has layer after layer, and cutting it can make our eyes water.

food-11.zh: 肉。肉煮熟了香香的，可以撕成小块。
food-11.en: Meat. Cooked meat smells good and can be torn into small pieces.

food-12.zh: 鱼肉。鱼肉软软的，吃之前大人会帮我们把刺挑出来。
food-12.en: Fish. Fish is soft, and a grown-up takes out the bones before we eat.

food-13.zh: 汤。汤盛在碗里，喝起来暖暖的。
food-13.en: Soup. Soup is served in a bowl and feels warm to drink.

food-14.zh: 饼干。饼干小小的，咬一口嘎吱响。
food-14.en: Cracker. A cracker is small and crunches when we bite it.

food-15.zh: 蛋糕。蛋糕软软的，上面抹着甜甜的奶油。
food-15.en: Cake. Cake is soft and topped with sweet cream.

food-16.zh: 糖果。糖果甜甜的，吃完要记得刷牙。
food-16.en: Candy. Candy is sweet, and we brush our teeth after eating it.

objects-32.zh: 气球。气球鼓鼓的，一松手就往天上飞。
objects-32.en: Balloon. A balloon is puffy and flies up when we let go.

objects-33.zh: 风筝。风筝有一根长长的线，有风的时候能飞很高。
objects-33.en: Kite. A kite has a long string and flies high when it is windy.

objects-34.zh: 蜡笔。蜡笔能画出彩色的线，盖好笔帽不容易干。
objects-34.en: Crayon. Crayons draw colorful lines, and putting the caps back keeps them from drying out.

objects-35.zh: 钥匙。钥匙插进锁孔一转，门就开了。
objects-35.en: Key. A key goes into the lock and turns to open the door.

objects-36.zh: 枕头。枕头软软的，睡觉的时候垫在头下面。
objects-36.en: Pillow. A pillow is soft and goes under our head when we sleep.

objects-37.zh: 扫把。扫把能把地上的碎屑扫到一起。
objects-37.en: Broom. A broom sweeps the crumbs on the floor into a pile.

transport-11.zh: 警车。警车会闪灯，提醒大家让一让。
transport-11.en: Police car. A police car flashes its lights to remind everyone to make way.

transport-12.zh: 摩托车。摩托车有两个轮子，跑起来声音很响。
transport-12.en: Motorcycle. A motorcycle has two wheels and sounds loud when it goes.

transport-13.zh: 洒水车。洒水车一边开一边洒水，把路面冲干净。
transport-13.en: Water truck. A water truck sprays water as it drives and washes the road.

transport-14.zh: 垃圾车。垃圾车把垃圾收走，让街道保持干净。
transport-14.en: Garbage truck. A garbage truck takes the rubbish away and keeps the street clean.

transport-15.zh: 热气球。热气球鼓得大大的，慢慢升上天空。
transport-15.en: Hot-air balloon. A hot-air balloon is big and round, and it rises slowly into the sky.

places-09.zh: 动物园。动物园里有好多动物，要隔着栏杆看。
places-09.en: Zoo. At the zoo we can see many animals from behind the railing.

places-10.zh: 海边。海边有沙子和小浪花，可以光脚踩水。
places-10.en: Seaside. At the seaside there is sand and gentle waves, and we can paddle barefoot.

places-11.zh: 餐厅。餐厅里可以坐下来吃饭，服务员会端来饭菜。
places-11.en: Restaurant. In a restaurant we sit down to eat and the waiter brings the food.

places-12.zh: 理发店。理发店可以剪头发，剪刀咔嚓咔嚓响。
places-12.en: Hair salon. At the hair salon we get a haircut, and the scissors go snip snip.

weather-26.zh: 春天。春天花开了，小草从土里钻出来。
weather-26.en: Spring. In spring the flowers open and the grass comes up.

weather-27.zh: 夏天。夏天很热，可以吃西瓜、玩水。
weather-27.en: Summer. Summer is hot, and we can eat watermelon and play with water.

weather-28.zh: 秋天。秋天树叶变黄，一片一片落下来。
weather-28.en: Autumn. In autumn the leaves turn yellow and fall one by one.

weather-29.zh: 冬天。冬天很冷，出门要穿厚厚的衣服。
weather-29.en: Winter. Winter is cold, and we wear thick clothes when we go out.

phrases-30.zh: 早上好。早上见到大人，可以说一句早上好。
phrases-30.en: Good morning. In the morning we can say good morning to a grown-up.

phrases-31.zh: 晚安。睡觉前轻轻说一句晚安。
phrases-31.en: Good night. Before sleep we say good night softly.

phrases-32.zh: 不客气。别人说谢谢的时候，可以回一句不客气。
phrases-32.en: You're welcome. When someone says thank you, we can answer you are welcome.

phrases-33.zh: 我要上厕所。想上厕所的时候说出来，大人就能帮忙。
phrases-33.en: I need the toilet. When we need the toilet, saying it lets a grown-up help.

phrases-34.zh: 我自己来。想自己试一试的时候，可以说我自己来。
phrases-34.en: I will do it myself. When we want to try alone, we can say I will do it myself.

phrases-35.zh: 等一下。还没做完的时候，可以说等一下。
phrases-35.en: Just a moment. When we are not finished yet, we can say just a moment.

phrases-36.zh: 再来一次。遇到喜欢的游戏，可以说再来一次。
phrases-36.en: Again please. For a game we enjoy, we can say again please.

phrases-37.zh: 小心。走路或者端水的时候，大人会说小心。
phrases-37.en: Careful. When we walk or carry water, a grown-up says careful.
